title: Accessibility review: Optimize > Suggestions (beta) page
creator: Tessa Morgan
description:
Run an accessibility review of the new Optimize > Suggestions (beta) page prior to expanding the private beta. Focus areas: keyboard navigation (table, filter chips, drawer), tooltips (risk badge + confidence + assumptions), color usage/contrast (risk badges + savings deltas), and screen reader labeling.

Scope includes: Suggestions list/table, sorting, filter chips, pagination, details drawer, disclaimers/assumptions section, empty states, and error states. Out of scope: broader Console nav, account-level settings pages (but confirm deep links are accessible).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Keyboard-only path is viable end-to-end: open page, change filters, sort, open/close drawer, navigate between suggestions, and activate primary links.
2) Focus is always visible with a 3:1 contrast ratio and does not get trapped in tooltips/drawer.
3) Risk badge + confidence UI is not color-only; text equivalent is announced to screen readers.
4) Tooltip content is reachable by keyboard and screen readers without requiring hover.
5) Color contrast meets WCAG AA for text/icons; any non-text indicators meet 3:1.
6) Table semantics are correct for screen readers (headers, row actions, expanded details).
7) Provide a short punch list for Eng (must-fix before beta expansion vs follow-ups).
audit_findings:
Reviewed build from console branch behind feature flag on 2026-02-18 (Nora’s staging env). Tested in Chrome + VoiceOver (macOS), NVDA (Windows), and keyboard-only. Cross-checked against WCAG 2.1 AA expectations.

Summary:
- Must-fix before expanding beta: 4 items
- Should-fix (beta acceptable if documented): 6 items
- Nice-to-have: 5 items

Must-fix:
1) Focus indicator missing/too subtle on table row click target (entire row is clickable but focus ring only appears on nested link in some rows). Impact: keyboard users can’t tell where they are.
2) Tooltip-only explanations for Risk/Confidence are not keyboard discoverable (hover-only). Impact: critical meaning is hidden.
3) Risk badge relies on color + short label only; SR announcement does not include full meaning (e.g., “High risk” without context that it’s performance/reliability risk). Impact: comprehension.
4) Drawer close button is not first/early in tab order; initial focus lands mid-drawer content. Impact: keyboard efficiency + predictable navigation.

Should-fix:
5) Filter chip remove (x) has ambiguous accessible name (“Remove”). Needs context (“Remove filter: Model = …”).
6) Sorting affordance in header is not announced as sortable state (ascending/descending) by SR.
7) Pagination controls lack clear aria-labels (“Next page of suggestions”, “Previous page”).
8) Savings delta formatting uses green/red and +/-; SR reads “minus” but doesn’t announce it’s estimated cost impact. Add visually-hidden prefix (“Estimated savings …”).
9) Confidence icon (shield) is announced as “image” with no label; needs alt/aria-label.
10) In empty state, primary CTA is accessible but the explanatory text references “enable telemetry” without a link; should add accessible link to setup docs.

Nice-to-have:
11) Add skip link to jump from filters to results table.
12) Consider a ‘Details’ button per row instead of full-row click target to reduce accidental activation.
13) Provide keyboard shortcut hints for closing drawer (Esc) in tooltip/help text.
14) In high contrast mode, risk badge backgrounds wash out; add border/outline treatment.
15) Reduce motion: drawer open animation should respect prefers-reduced-motion.
recommendations:
Design recommendations (copy + UI behavior):
- Tooltips: ensure info is reachable via keyboard by adding an explicit “Info” icon button next to Risk and Confidence labels that toggles a popover (focusable) rather than hover-only tooltip. Popover should be dismissible (Esc, click outside) and should trap focus only if it contains interactive controls (otherwise no trap).
- Risk/Confidence: treat badge text as the primary indicator. Colors can remain but must be supplementary. Add consistent tooltip/popover copy that states: “Risk reflects potential latency/reliability impact, not security risk.”
- Drawer: initial focus should land on drawer title (h2) or close button. Close button should be first tabbable element. Esc should close.
- Table: avoid full-row click target. Prefer a dedicated “View details” button/link per row with clear focus state. If full-row click is retained, make the row a single focusable element with a strong focus ring and avoid nested interactive elements to prevent multiple tab stops.
- Color: verify contrast for badge text on badge background (esp. Medium). If contrast fails, switch to darker text or add border + lighter background. Ensure icons meet 3:1 against adjacent color.
decisions:
Decisions from design review (2026-02-20):
- We will add explicit “Info” icon buttons to open popovers for Risk and Confidence (replacing hover-only tooltips for those columns). (Owner: Kenji; Eng partner: Nora)
- We will keep risk colors but update palette + add border to ensure WCAG AA compliance and high-contrast resilience. (Owner: Alicia)
- We will shift from full-row click to a dedicated “Details” link/button in the rightmost column to simplify keyboard navigation. (Owner: Kenji; requires small layout update in DES-611 follow-up)
- Drawer initial focus: close button first, then title. Esc closes drawer. (Owner: Nora / Eng)
- We will add visually-hidden labels for savings and confidence icon for SR clarity. (Owner: Nora / Eng)
implementation_notes:
Eng notes (shared with ENG-19358):
- Use real <button> elements for interactive controls; avoid div role=button.
- For sortable headers: aria-sort on <th> and announce state changes.
- For popovers: use focus management consistent with existing Console popover patterns; ensure trigger is reachable; include aria-expanded + aria-controls.
- Add aria-labels:
  - Filter chip remove: “Remove filter: <label>”
  - Pagination: “Next page of suggestions”, “Previous page”, “Page X”
  - Confidence icon: “Confidence: High/Medium/Low”
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion by reducing drawer animation duration to 0 or using a fade.
qa_notes:
QA checklist for accessibility regression (to include in E2E/QA passes):
- Keyboard: can reach filters, open/close popovers, move to table, activate Details, close drawer with Esc, return focus to initiating row.
- Screen reader: announces column headers, row context, risk/confidence text + expanded explanation, sort state.
- Contrast: verify risk badge (Low/Medium/High) in light + dark themes and in high-contrast mode.
- Tooltip/popover: does not disappear on focus; dismissible.
- Empty/error states: CTAs reachable and descriptive; links have meaningful text.

Suggested test environments: Chrome + NVDA, Safari + VoiceOver, and one mobile screen reader pass once layout is stable.
